senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; חָסַד I)kind, God-fearing, submissive, pious, abstemious.
units: <cite ref="Temurah 15b:56">Tem. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>כל היכא דאמר מעשה בח׳ אחד וכ׳</he> wherever we read (in Talmudic writings), ‘It is reported of a pious man’, either R. Juda b. Baba it meant or &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 3:4">Sot. III, 4</cite> <he>ח׳ שוטה</he> a foolish saint.
Ab. V, 10 שלי … ח׳ he who says, Mine is thine and thine is thine, is a ḥasid.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:1">Ber. V, 1</cite> <he>ח׳ הראשונים</he> the pious men of olden days; a. v. fr.
